name: The Stone Watcher
summary: At the Uldum Pedestal, The Stone Watcher guards the way into the compound. You have carried the platinum discs across Tanaris, and now it asks you to learn its story before you go on.

sections.title: A Guardian at the Pedestal
sections.body: At the Uldum Pedestal, the Stone Watcher blocks the way into the Uldum compound. You brought the platinum discs across Tanaris. The guardian says entry is allowed only when the Plates of Uldum are part of your set. Learn the Watcher's story, then use the pedestal.

sections.title: What the Watcher Explains
sections.body:
The Stone Watcher controls entry to the Uldum complex for the Creators. It admits only those with the proper sequencing discs. The Plates of Uldum are made by the Creators and record their work at Uldum. They are nearly the size of your own discs, but their markings concern Uldum rather than Uldaman.

Uldum is a research facility where the Creators work to enhance Azeroth's biosphere. Only those who hold the Plates can learn the details of that work. The Watcher promises to return your discs once you access the pedestal. It will let you enter the complex when the Plates are in your set.

sections.title: More From the Watcher
sections.body: The Stone Watcher says the Creators control the distribution of discs for every complex on this world. Azeroth has been rescheduled for a visitation. The Creators use visitation to restore control over seeded worlds when forces from outside or within upset the balance of their matrix dynamics. The Watcher warns that visitation is not to be taken lightly.

faq.q: Who is the Stone Watcher of Norgannon?
aliases: who is the watcher at uldum
faq.answer: At the Uldum Pedestal in Tanaris, the Stone Watcher guards entry to the Uldum compound and decides who may enter.

faq.q: Why does the Stone Watcher deny entry?
faq.answer: The Stone Watcher admits only those whose disc set includes the Plates of Uldum. Your set does not yet include them.
